actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE new full-body game animation sprite for 09_bamboo_archer_girl, SOUTH facing directly toward the viewer, WALK frame 01 of a 16-frame seamless 480ms cycle. Not a sprite sheet.
Reference image 1 is the exact original identity: preserve this cheerful green-eyed round-faced chibi girl, dark brown long high ponytail, jade bamboo-leaf gold hair clasp, pale yellow-green ribbons, jade earrings, green-and-ivory layered short Taoist tunic, gold leaf embroidery, ivory shorts, green/gold/ivory boots, yin-yang belt buckle and green tassel, bamboo bow and matching quiver. Preserve her exact face, 2.4-head-tall proportions, costume construction and equipment. Reference image 2 is ONLY the approved painting style and finish: clean bright rounded Chinese fantasy hand-painted volume; no UI, text, backdrop or extra ornaments.
Draw a relaxed traveling WALK, not an archery attack. Carry the bamboo bow lowered safely at her left side with one hand, bowstring relaxed, no nocked arrow. Quiver remains attached on her back. Both short legs and both boots are clearly readable below the tunic.
Pose S01: anatomical left leg (screen right) reaching forward toward camera in initial heel contact; anatomical right leg (screen left) behind with toe on ground, knee soft, heel beginning to release. Feet separate, not crossed. Modest natural walking stride, at least one foot contacts ground. Slight opposing right-arm swing, shoulders level, pleasant closed-mouth soft smile. Arms and equipment remain close enough to fit. Ponytail and hems follow the motion mildly.
Fixed camera: orthographic character-sprite view, slightly looking down by about 10 degrees, body yaw exactly SOUTH front. Full figure plus entire bow and quiver, generous safety margin, no cropping. Square native canvas at least 1024x1024, preferably 1536x1536; highest available visual quality. Character from hair ornament to grounded soles occupies about 84 percent of canvas height, body axis at horizontal center, soles baseline at 92 percent height. Genuine transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no colored matte, no ground shadow, no glow, no outline fringe. Consistent soft upper-left lighting, crisp clean alpha edge, fine detailed painting matching the identity. One complete newly drawn pose only; no collage, duplication, mirroring, motion blur, labels or watermark.
